datafile.description: Input data file path; read from stdin if not specified.

port.description: Port on which to send DNS packets. Defaults to 53 for UDP/TCP, 853 for DoT, 443 for DoH.

max_qps.description: Maximum queries per second. Null means no limit.

local_port.description: Local port to bind to. 0 means wildcard.

stats_interval.description: Interval in seconds to print per-interval statistics.

limit.description: Time limit in seconds for the test run.

runs_through_file.description: Maximum number of times to run through the input file.

edns.description: Enable EDNS0 by setting OPT record (-e).

tsig.description: TSIG key spec in format '[alg:]name:secret' (base64-encoded secret).

tls_sni.description: TLS Server Name Indication (SNI) for DoT/DoH.

suppress.description: List of message types to suppress: timeouts, congestion, sendfailed, sockready, unexpected.

num_queries_per_conn.description: Max queries per connection before reconnect (connection-oriented modes only).

latency_histogram.description: Enable detailed latency histogram output (-O latency-histogram).

verbose_interval_stats.description: Change -S output to per-interval latency stats (-O verbose-interval-stats).

qps_threshold_wait.description: Minimum microseconds between queries for nanosleep() — controls QPS precision.
